name: dbgauss-glass-schemes-demo
description: Demonstration of scheme comparison on the synthetic test model dbgauss: the sample's own SCHOTT glasses, the nearest CDGM glasses and the nearest HOYA glasses (from the D8 candidate lists), each optimized with the same one-stage AUT spec; a fourth scheme changes the vignetting factors, whose error function values cannot be compared directly with the others. All values are demonstration values.

schemes.name: cdgm
schemes.reason: nearest CDGM glasses for F15 and SK16

schemes.name: hoya
schemes.reason: nearest HOYA glasses for F15 and SK16

schemes.name: vignetted
schemes.reason: sample glasses with more vignetting at fields 2 and 3
